title: Mankey picks up its noticed moving Pokémon, throws it away from the player, and follows again

verification.actor: Current FOLLOWER Mankey56 and one WILD Bellsprout69, bound as both noticed Object of interest and Cargo through the same full native handle, subject and engine identity.
verification.trigger: Prepare only party/placement and one native Bell spawn. Use normal neutral frames for sight, exact-Interest Cargo capture, pursuit, pickup and Away launch. Then Right32 and neutral frames complete normal Follower return. No Y input, conditions, timers, claims or motion state are forced.
verification.observable: Sight and exact-Interest Cargo conditions in Pickup bind the same current Bellsprout. Before carry, its own accepted move either completes with native commit and control return, or the same moving Cargo has an exact native cancel, control return and HELD handoff. The carrier is never canceled. Mankey completes an authored half-speed Cargo Hop, resolves held Find Position plus Follower Away target14 at half speed, and launches that same Bell to an accepted native cardinal endpoint at exact Throw range8 with greater Chebyshev distance from Player. The full native flight reaches its timed commit, landing and control return. Mankey clears held claims/bindings and completes normal base7 follow movement. Any admitted Position Hop must complete; no Position Hop is required when the current pickup tile already admits a legal Away line. The first complete unlimited Cargo Hop retains its exact current query key and graph through native return. While the target is free, retain its actual unclaimed native profile baseline and require the same complete resolved profile, native AUTO control, no early cancellation, and dense elapsed/render progress for an accepted move under the claim. Only actual pickup may transfer the target to native HELD control. This finite fixture must not trigger unrelated target-profile changes.
